# ran:      2026-08-06T20:20:13.8694741-07:00
# why:      dxc sends DXASSERT text to OutputDebugString and then __debugbreak()s,
#           so a plain run shows only 'Internal compiler error: Terminal Error
#           0x80000003' on stderr with no message, file or line. See
#           include/dxc/Support/Global.h (DXASSERT / DXASSERT_NOMSG).
# NOTE:     hand-driven capture, not a probe. Not scored by match.json.
#
# CASE 1 is repro.hlsl with the exact arguments in cmd.txt. The assert is
#        DXASSERT_NOMSG(Ty) at lib/DXIL/DxilUtil.cpp:877 in WrapInArrayTypes,
#        called from TranslatePtrIfUsedByLoweredFn -- the frame named in the
#        issue title.
# CASE 2 is control-scalar-payload.hlsl, the same shader with a legal uint payload.
#        No trap: the only break is the loader's initial one, and the stack after
#        'g' shows the process exiting normally through ExitProcessImplementation.
#        Paths in the DXIL output are elided; see variant-control-scalar-payload-main-debug.txt
#        for the full successful compile.
